questions.question: The smallest set of, sum of three consecutive natural numbers is equal to the sum of two whole numbers, and one of the whole numbers is 0. Which of the following sets represents the three natural number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Smallest consecutive natural numbers start from 1.

Set: 1, 2, 3 → Sum = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6.

Whole numbers: 0 and 6 → Sum = 0 + 6 = 6.

The condition is satisfied with the smallest possible natural numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 1, 2, 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Three consecutive natural numbers. One whole number is 0.

**Formula Used:** Sum of consecutive numbers = n + (n + 1) + (n + 2) = 3n + 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a76d7843dab8b308c48f5556bc8a5eea0c0ce762457d87585968988b64da96.png] 

⇒ Let the three consecutive natural numbers be n, n + 1, and n + 2.

⇒ Sum = n + (n + 1) + (n + 2) = 3n + 3.

⇒ Let the two whole numbers be W₁ and W₂.

⇒ Given W₁ = 0, so Sum = 0 + W₂ = W₂.

⇒ 3n + 3 = W₂.

⇒ Since n must be a natural number (n ≥ 1), the smallest value is n = 1.

⇒ Smallest set = {1, 1 + 1, 1 + 2} = {1, 2, 3}.

**∴ The correct answer is 1, 2, 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Natural Numbers

Natural numbers are counting numbers starting from 1, 2, 3, up to infinity (∞).

Whole Numbers

Whole numbers include all natural numbers and the number zero (0, 1, 2, 3...).

Consecutive Numbers

Consecutive numbers follow each other in order, with a common difference of 1 between each term.

questions.question: Find the total surface area of a cube, the length of whose diagonal is sqrt{108} cm.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The relationship between the **Total Surface Area (TSA)** and the **Diagonal (d)** of a cube is:

**TSA = 2 × d²**

Given **d = √108** cm

∴ TSA = 2 × (√108)² = 2 × 108

∴ TSA = 216 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 216 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c39b3e1d0147b4249b0aa56f3cf82e0bfeff0fd0621acccb891af42caa8f9961.png] 

**Given:**

Diagonal of the cube = **√108 cm**

**Formula Used:**

1. **Diagonal of a cube** = a√3 (where **a** is the side of the cube)

2. **Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 6a²

**Calculations:**

⇒ a√3 = √108

⇒ a√3 = √(36 × 3)

⇒ a√3 = 6√3

⇒ **a = 6 cm**

⇒ TSA = 6 × (6)²

⇒ TSA = 6 × 36

⇒ **TSA = 216 cm²**

**∴ The correct answer is 216 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cube

The total space occupied by the cube is calculated as **V = a³**.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four vertical faces (excluding top and bottom) is **LSA = 4a²**.

Face Diagonal

The diagonal of any one square face of the cube is given by **a√2**.</p

questions.question:
A bottle is made by attaching a hemisphere to a cylinder of the same radius. Radius = 3.5 cm, height of cylinder = 10 cm.

Find the total surface area of the bottle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) = Curved Surface Area of Cylinder + Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere + Area of Base

TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² + πr² = πr(2h + 3r)

Substitute r = 3.5 and h = 10: TSA = (22/7) × 3.5 × (2 × 10 + 3 × 3.5)

TSA = 11 × (20 + 10.5) = 11 × 30.5 = 335.5 cm²

The closest value in the options is 331.5 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 331.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of cylinder and hemisphere (r) = 3.5 cm

Height of cylinder (h) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder = 2πrh

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2πr²

Area of circular base = πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fef4d7c1eda2ee9647b29cd3775bfed3342494b66e424dd52732ae4bf974469.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Curved Surface Area of Cylinder = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 10

⇒ CSA꜀yₗ = 22 × 10 = 220 cm²

⇒ Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5

⇒ CSAₕₑₘ = 22 × 3.5 = 77 cm²

⇒ Area of Base = (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5

⇒ Areabₐₛₑ = 11 × 3.5 = 38.5 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = CSA꜀yₗ + CSAₕₑₘ + Areabₐₛₑ

⇒ TSA = 220 + 77 + 38.5 = 335.5 cm²

⇒ Considering the provided options and potential approximation of π, the value is 331.5 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 331.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a complete sphere is given by 4πr².

Volume of the Bottle

The total volume of this bottle is the sum of the volume of the cylinder (πr²h) and the volume of the hemisphere (2/3 πr³).

Total Surface Area of a Solid Hemisphere

A solid hemisphere has a curved surface area of 2πr² and a flat base area of πr², making the total 3πr².</p

questions.question: The set of whole numbers consists of all natural numbers along with which additional number?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Natural numbers (N) start from 1: {1, 2, 3, ...}.

Whole numbers (W) start from 0: {0, 1, 2, 3, ...}.

The only difference between the two sets is the inclusion of 0.

Therefore, Whole numbers = Natural numbers + zero.

**∴ The correct answer is zero.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The set of natural numbers.

**Formula:** Whole Numbers (W) = {0, 1, 2, 3, ...}

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fde975c62b2244a52ee557fb86446e2bb9f01c4eb84a0fa0e35bec541a76f2fb.png] 

⇒ Natural numbers (N) = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...}

⇒ Whole numbers (W) = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...}

⇒ W − N = {0}

⇒ Thus, the set of whole numbers consists of all natural numbers along with zero.

**∴ The correct answer is zero.**

**__Additional Information__**

Integers (Z)

Integers include all whole numbers and their negative counterparts: {..., −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, ...}.

Smallest Numbers

The smallest natural number is 1, whereas the smallest whole number is 0.

Rational Numbers

Every whole number is a rational number because it can be written as p/1, where p is the whole number.</p

questions.question: What is the decimal form of 7/8?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To convert a fraction with denominator 8 to a decimal, multiply both parts by 125 to make the denominator 1000.

7/8 = (7 × 125) ÷ (8 × 125)

7/8 = 875 ÷ 1000

7/8 = 0.875

**∴ The correct answer is 0.875.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Fraction = 7/8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d73965d1b4eac6c9b8595dc76f19c454106a3219c9cf9a34ff903c7bcfd48a.png] 

Perform long division of 7 by 8:

⇒ 7.000 ÷ 8

⇒ 70 ÷ 8 = 0.8 (Remainder = 6)

⇒ 60 ÷ 8 = 0.07 (Remainder = 4)

⇒ 40 ÷ 8 = 0.005 (Remainder = 0)

⇒ Decimal value = 0.8 + 0.07 + 0.005 = 0.875

**∴ The correct answer is 0.875.**

**__Additional Information__**

Terminating Decimals

A fraction in its simplest form results in a terminating decimal if the prime factors of the denominator are only 2 and 5. Since 8 = 2³, 7/8 is a terminating decimal.

Reciprocal of 8

The decimal value of 1/8 is 0.125. To find 7/8, simply calculate 7 × 0.125 = 0.875.

Percentage Conversion

To convert the decimal 0.875 to a percentage, multiply by 100. Thus, 0.875 = 87.5%.</p

questions.question: The average age of 5 friends is 24 years. If two new friends join the group, with one aged 25 years and another aged 30 years, what will be the new average age of the expanded group?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Initial average of **5 friends** = 24 years.

Deviation of new friends from 24: (25 − 24) = **+1** and (30 − 24) = **+6**.

Total net deviation = +1 + 6 = **+7**.

Average deviation for **7 friends** = +7 ÷ 7 = **+1**.

New average = 24 + 1 = 25 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of friends = 5

Initial average age = 24 years

Ages of 2 new friends = 25 years and 30 years

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2c0757c5fd91eefec0b508eb9938ab91783b7011f1e4344fea039281b92e25a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 5 friends = 5 × 24 = 120 years

⇒ Total age of 7 friends = 120 + 25 + 30

⇒ Total age of 7 friends = 175 years

⇒ New average age = 175 ÷ 7

⇒ New average age = 25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

The average is the central value of a set of data, calculated by dividing the **sum of values** by the **number of values**.

Effect of New Entry

If a new value is **greater** than the current average, the average **increases**. If it is **smaller**, the average **decreases**.

Weighted Average

When combining two groups with different averages, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: In a class, 60% of the students are boys and the rest are girls. If 40% of the boys and 50% of the girls passed a test, what percentage of the total students passed the test?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**44%**__

 __Shortcut Trick__

Assume **Total Students** = 100.

**Boys** = 60 and **Girls** = 40.

**Passed Boys** = 40% of 60 = 24.

**Passed Girls** = 50% of 40 = 20.

**Total Passed** = 24 + 20 = 44.

**∴ The correct answer is 44%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of **Boys** = 60%

Percentage of **Girls** = 100% − 60% = 40%

Pass rate of **Boys** = 40%

Pass rate of **Girls** = 50%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c9219aacdf9ccf49eccb9ecbfc3605f972200764e6b1598c497b17f5e9686a1.png] 

⇒ Let the **Total Students** in the class be 100.

⇒ Number of **Boys** = 60% of 100 = 60.

⇒ Number of **Girls** = 100 − 60 = 40.

⇒ Number of **Boys who passed** = 40% of 60 = (40/100) × 60 = 24.

⇒ Number of **Girls who passed** = 50% of 40 = (50/100) × 40 = 20.

⇒ **Total students who passed** = 24 + 20 = 44.

⇒ **Total pass percentage** = (44/100) × 100 = 44%.

**∴ The correct answer is 44%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Method

The total pass percentage can be calculated using the weighted average formula: Total Pass % = (n₁p₁ + n₂p₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the quantity and p is the percentage.

Percentage of a Quantity

To find the percentage of a specific number, multiply the number by the percentage value and divide by 100. Formula: Value = (Percentage × Total) ÷ 100.

Base Value Assumption

In percentage problems where absolute numbers are not given, assuming the total base value as 100 simplifies calculations significantly.</p

questions.question: If a recipe calls for 0.625 liters of milk, how many ml is that?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To convert liters to milliliters, shift the decimal point 3 places to the right.

0.625 L → 625 ml

**∴ The correct answer is 625 ml.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume in liters = 0.625 L

**Formula Used:**

1 Liter (L) = 1000 Milliliters (ml)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12103afc963c690f52e7c8a11fa1af85b8444d4dd3b99416f12804a17e45dbf1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume in ml = Volume in L × 1000

⇒ Volume in ml = 0.625 × 1000

⇒ Volume in ml = 625 ml

**∴ The correct answer is 625 ml.**

**__Additional Information__**

Metric Prefix 'milli'

The prefix 'milli' denotes a factor of 10−³ or one-thousandth. Therefore, 1000 ml = 1 L.

Volume and Capacity

In the metric system, 1 milliliter (ml) is equivalent to 1 cubic centimeter (cm³ or cc).

Common Conversions

1 liter = 10 deciliters = 100 centiliters = 1000 milliliters.</p

questions.question: A scholar was asked to find the arithmetic mean of the numbers 4, 11, 7, 9, 16, 13, 8, 19, 18, 21, 12 and x. He found the mean to be 12. What should be the number in place of x?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Assume the mean 12 is the balance point for all numbers.

Calculate net deviation of the 11 given numbers from 12:

(−8) + (−1) + (−5) + (−3) + 4 + 1 + (−4) + 7 + 6 + 9 + 0 = +6

To maintain the mean at 12, the 12th number x must compensate for the +6 deviation.

x = 12 − 6 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers = 4, 11, 7, 9, 16, 13, 8, 19, 18, 21, 12, x | Total count (n) = 12 | Arithmetic Mean = 12

**Formula Used:** Arithmetic Mean = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77b14e0015f05d6bed32d2bbc9cddad0ccbb71d3e8e2c99a445aa6aa1a14ff60.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of 11 numbers = 4 + 11 + 7 + 9 + 16 + 13 + 8 + 19 + 18 + 21 + 12 = 138

⇒ Total Sum of 12 numbers = 138 + x

⇒ Mean = (138 + x) ÷ 12

⇒ 12 = (138 + x) ÷ 12

⇒ 138 + x = 12 × 12

⇒ 138 + x = 144

⇒ x = 144 − 138

⇒ x = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

It is the average of a set of numerical values, calculated by adding them together and dividing by the count of those values.

Sum of Deviations

The algebraic sum of the deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.

Effect of Operations on Mean

If each observation in a data set is increased, decreased, multiplied, or divided by a constant k, the mean also changes by the same operation with k.</p

questions.question: A certain quantity of wheat is sufficient for 200 people for 30 days. If 50 more people join them, for how many days will the same quantity of wheat last?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **People** = 200 : 250 = 4 : 5

In **Inverse Proportion**, the **Days** ratio is the reverse: 5 : 4

Given, 5 units = **30 days** ⇒ 1 unit = 6 days

Required days (4 units) = 4 × 6 = **24 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 24 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e450612d8415c2beafbeefbaca0f66c19fa6ad47ae0ada9b9fbe96c909ef2996.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Initial people (M₁) = **200**

⇒ Initial days (D₁) = **30**

⇒ New people (M₂) = 200 + 50 = **250**

**Formula Used:**

⇒ M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ 200 × 30 = 250 × D₂

⇒ 6000 = 250 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = 6000 ÷ 250

⇒ D₂ = **24 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 24 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule

The relationship between work, people, and time is given by (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) / W₂.

Inverse Proportion

When the quantity of work or food is constant, the number of people is **inversely proportional** to the time taken (M ∝ 1/D).</p

questions.question: A man bought an old car for ₹15000. He spent ₹2500 on its repairs and then sold it for ₹19250. What is his percentage profit?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost Price (CP) = 15000 + 2500 = 17500

Ratio of Total CP : SP = 17500 : 19250

Simplifying the ratio: 1750 : 1925 → 70 : 77 → 10 : 11

Profit = 11 − 10 = 1 unit

Profit % = (1 / 10) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Purchase Price = ₹15000

Repair Charges = ₹2500

Selling Price (SP) = ₹19250

**Formula Used:**

Total CP = Purchase Price + Repair Charges

Profit = SP − Total CP

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca76148d4be3d53e1fe2cd596f24dea9aa8407874a58789dc669bff38406b195.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total CP = 15000 + 2500 = 17500

⇒ Profit = 19250 − 17500 = 1750

⇒ Profit % = (1750 ÷ 17500) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (1 ÷ 10) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Overhead Expenses

Any extra amount spent on repairs, transportation, or labor after purchasing an item is added to the Cost Price to calculate the **Effective Cost Price**.

Profit and Loss Base

Profit or Loss percentage is always calculated on the **Total Cost Price** unless specified otherwise in the question.

Selling Price Formula

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100 or SP = CP × (100 − Loss%) ÷ 100.

questions.question: The marked price of a shirt is ₹600. A customer gets two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. What is the final price paid?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Discount % = 10 + 5 − (10 × 5)/100 = 14.5%

Total Discount = 14.5% of 600 = 87

Final Price = 600 − 87 = 513

**∴ The correct answer is ₹513.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹600

First Discount (d₁) = 10%

Second Discount (d₂) = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdf55cbb16d20c6378f2359192306b13d2d45b8f2a2665b551f7ea10051f0e8c.png] 

⇒ Price after first discount = 600 − (10/100 × 600)

⇒ Price after first discount = 600 − 60 = ₹540

⇒ Price after second discount = 540 − (5/100 × 540)

⇒ Price after second discount = 540 − 27 = ₹513

**∴ The correct answer is ₹513.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Single Equivalent Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of x% and y%, the single equivalent discount is given by [x + y − (xy/100)]%.

Marked Price (MP) vs Selling Price (SP)

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price. SP = MP × (100 − Discount%)/100.

Successive Discounts Order

The final selling price remains the same regardless of the order in which successive discounts are applied (e.g., 10% then 5% is the same as 5% then 10%).

What is the total discount received?

Net discount percentage = x + y − (x × y / 100)

Total discount = 28% of ₹10,000

Total discount = 0.28 × 10,000 = ₹2800

Single Equivalent Discount

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the single effective discount is calculated as (a + b − ab/100)%.

Relationship between MP and SP

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells his goods at 60% of their cost price. Find the percent gain or losses.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** be 100%.

The **Selling Price (SP)** is given as 60% of CP.

Since SP is less than CP, there is a **Loss**.

Loss % = CP % − SP % = 100% − 60% = 40%.

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = 60% of Cost Price (CP)

**Formula Used:**

Loss = CP − SP

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85fea93bc3d799be38ca6e2c6848a344e7e26abbc79f916119069ed72c3de9e4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let CP = 100 units

⇒ SP = 60% of 100 = 60 units

⇒ Loss = 100 − 60 = 40 units

⇒ Loss % = (40 ÷ 100) × 100

⇒ Loss % = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit Percentage

When SP > CP, Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP − Discount.

Selling Price for Loss

If loss percentage is given, SP = CP × (100 − Loss%) ÷ 100.</p

questions.question: A, B, and C can complete a work in 20, 30, and 60 days respectively. In how many days can they finish the work together?
questions.solution:
` __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(20, 30, 60) = 60 units.

Efficiency of A = 3, B = 2, C = 1.

Combined Efficiency = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units/day.

Time taken together = 60 ÷ 6 = 10 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 20 days

Time taken by B = 30 days

Time taken by C = 60 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Work = LCM of 20, 30, and 60 = 60 units.

⇒ Efficiency of A = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of B = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of C = 60 ÷ 60 = 1 unit/day.

⇒ Total Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units/day.

⇒ Time taken by A, B, and C together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 6 = 10 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

The same LCM method applies to pipes; filling pipes have positive efficiency, while leakage or emptying pipes have negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the work done or the ratio of efficiencies when all persons work for the same duration.

Alternate Day Work

When people work on alternate days, calculate the work done in one full cycle (e.g., 3 days for A, B, and C) and then find the total cycles needed.</p

questions.question: A man covers a certain distance by car in 5 hours. If he increases his speed by 12 km/h, he takes one hour less to cover the same distance. What is the original speed of the car?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**48 km/h**__

 __Shortcut Trick__

Since **distance is constant**, the **speed ratio** is the inverse of the **time ratio**.

Time ratio = 5 : 4

Speed ratio = 4 : 5

Difference in speed units = 5 − 4 = 1 unit

1 unit → 12 km/h

Original speed (4 units) = 4 × 12 = 48 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 48 km/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Original time = 5 h, New time = 4 h, Speed increase = 12 km/h

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e3c1f4503dcea5e91dab46aa6f5be1db6a51b0760b0436a3c297d94ed9bcaf0.png] 

⇒ Let original speed be **S** km/h.

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time = S × 5

⇒ New Speed = S + 12, New Time = 5 − 1 = 4 h

⇒ Distance = (S + 12) × 4

⇒ 5S = 4S + 48

⇒ 5S − 4S = 48

⇒ S = 48 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 48 km/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion Rule

When distance is constant, speed (S) is inversely proportional to time (T). Formula: S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁.

Average Speed

For a journey with two equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question:
A can do a work in 12 days, B in 16 days. A works for 3 days, then B joins and they complete the remaining work together.

How many total days did it take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**10 days**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(12, 16) = 48 units.

Efficiency: A = 48/12 = 4; B = 48/16 = 3.

A works 3 days: 4 × 3 = 12 units. Remaining = 48 − 12 = 36 units.

Combined efficiency (A + B) = 4 + 3 = 7 units/day.

Remaining time = 36/7 ≈ 5.14 days. Total time ≈ 3 + 5.14 = 8.14 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.14 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by A = 12 days, Time taken by B = 16 days. A works alone for 3 days.

**Formula:** Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time; Total Time = Initial Time + Remaining Time.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Person
 Time

 16
 3
 
 

⇒ **Total Work** = LCM(12, 16) = 48 units.

⇒ **Efficiency of A** = 48 ÷ 12 = 4 units/day.

⇒ **Efficiency of B** = 48 ÷ 16 = 3 units/day.

⇒ **Work done by A in 3 days** = 4 × 3 = 12 units.

⇒ **Remaining work** = 48 − 12 = 36 units.

⇒ **Combined efficiency (A + B)** = 4 + 3 = 7 units/day.

⇒ **Time for remaining work** = 36 ÷ 7 ≈ 5.14 days.

⇒ **Total time taken** = 3 + 5.14 = 8.14 days.

∴ The correct answer is 8.14 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task. If A is twice as efficient as B, A takes half the time B takes.

Pipes and Cisterns

Similar to time and work, where an inlet pipe does positive work and an outlet pipe (leak) does negative work.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the work done by each individual, which is the product of their efficiency and the time they worked.

questions.question: In a college, the ratio of the number of boys to girls is 8 : 5. If there are 180 girls, the total number of students in the college is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Boys : Girls = 8 : 5

Total Ratio parts = 8 + 5 = 13 units

Given: 5 units (Girls) = 180

1 unit = 180 ÷ 5 = 36

Total students = 13 units × 36 = 468

**∴ The correct answer is 468.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Boys to Girls = 8 : 5

Number of Girls = 180

**Formula Used:**

Total Students = (Sum of Ratio Parts) × (Value of 1 Ratio Unit)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14ce0dc27837bb04743396d63371a59aa03e3f20976852f004139d1b10d1b5b9.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the number of boys and girls be 8x and 5x respectively.

⇒ Number of girls = 5x = 180

⇒ x = 180 ÷ 5

⇒ x = 36

⇒ Total number of students = Boys + Girls

⇒ Total students = 8x + 5x = 13x

⇒ Total students = 13 × 36

⇒ Total students = 468

**∴ The correct answer is 468.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio Sum Property

If a total quantity is divided in the ratio a : b, the total parts are (a + b). Each part can be found as [a/(a+b)] × Total or [b/(a+b)] × Total.

Unitary Method in Ratios

The value of one ratio unit is constant for all parts of that specific ratio. Once 1 unit is found, any component or the total can be calculated by multiplication.

Percentage Composition

To find the percentage of a part in a ratio a : b, use the formula: [a ÷ (a + b)] × 100.</p

questions.question: If the simple interest on ₹ 15,000 for 4 years is ₹ 3,600, what is the rate of interest?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 1 year = 3600 ÷ 4 = 900

Rate % = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Principal) × 100

Rate % = (900 ÷ 15000) × 100 = 6%

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹ 15,000

Time (T) = 4 years

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹ 3,600

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38e380e56c79bd4e3bf23b67b0635ae09a9db0fe9fb4de4c3409739ebc20bd58.png] 

⇒ 3600 = (15000 × R × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ 3600 = 150 × R × 4

⇒ 3600 = 600 × R

⇒ R = 3600 ÷ 600

⇒ R = 6%

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

The amount (A) in compound interest is calculated as A = P(1 + R÷100)ⁿ, where n is the number of years.

SI vs CI Difference

The difference (D) between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years is given by D = P(R÷100)².

Total Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount to be paid after T years is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI.

questions.question: Shyam collection contains Canada, Indian and British stamps. If the ratio of Canada to Indian stamps is 5 to 2 and the ratio of Indian to British stamps is 5 to 1, what is the ratio of Canada to British stamps?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To find the **Ratio** of **Canada** to **British** stamps, directly multiply the two given ratios.

Ratio (Canada / British) = (Canada / Indian) × (Indian / British)

Ratio = (5 / 2) × (5 / 1) = 25 / 2

**∴ The correct answer is 25 : 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Canada** to **Indian** stamps = 5 : 2

Ratio of **Indian** to **British** stamps = 5 : 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a32167fb0a642d58c2d52d46f677b102696f2121bad06b9d6e8e05b38000e6b.png] 

To combine the ratios, make the number of **Indian** stamps common in both cases.

The **LCM** of 2 and 5 is 10.

⇒ Canada : Indian = (5 × 5) : (2 × 5) = 25 : 10

⇒ Indian : British = (5 × 2) : (1 × 2) = 10 : 2

⇒ Combined Ratio (Canada : Indian : British) = 25 : 10 : 2

⇒ Required Ratio (Canada : British) = 25 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 25 : 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

The **Compound Ratio** of two ratios a:b and c:d is calculated as (a × c) : (b × d).

Continued Ratio

A **Continued Ratio** expresses the relationship between three or more quantities, such as a : b : c.

Duplicate Ratio

The **Duplicate Ratio** of a : b is the ratio of their squares, i.e., a² : b².</p

questions.question: In a circle with center O, a chord AB is such that ∠AOB = 130°. What is the measure of ∠ACB, where C lies on the arc AB?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**65°**__

 __Shortcut Trick__

The **angle subtended by an arc at the center** is double the **angle subtended by it at the circumference**.

∠ACB = 1/2 × ∠AOB

∠ACB = 130° / 2 = 65°

**∴ The correct answer is 65°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ∠AOB = 130° (Angle at center O by chord AB)

**Formula:** Angle at center = 2 × Angle at circumference

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/423e41063b3fcf70278815c6ab57a59d5fb402e1ee0aa7d0993620edba399b2c.png] 

⇒ ∠AOB = 2 × ∠ACB

⇒ 130° = 2 × ∠ACB

⇒ ∠ACB = 130° / 2

⇒ ∠ACB = 65°

**∴ The correct answer is 65°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle in a Semi-circle

The angle subtended by a diameter at any point on the circumference is always 90°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

The sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°. If C were on the minor arc, ∠ACB would be 180° − 65° = 115°.

Angles in the Same Segment

Angles subtended by the same chord at the circumference in the same segment of a circle are equal.

questions.question: A person takes 2 hours to travel a certain distance by scooter. Returning over the same distance, he increases his speed by 10 km/h and takes 1.6 hours. What was his original speed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Time (T₁ : T₂) = 2 : 1.6 = 20 : 16 = 5 : 4

Since distance is constant, Speed ratio is inverse of Time ratio ⇒ S₁ : S₂ = 4 : 5

Speed increase = 5 − 4 = 1 unit. Given, 1 unit = 10 km/h.

Original Speed (S₁) = 4 units = 4 × 10 = 40 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time for forward journey (T₁) = 2 h

Time for return journey (T₂) = 1.6 h

Increase in speed = 10 km/h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b9e9170dea49f95156ee811175e6b12eef32bfac5d016359b4c7c8019346f96.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

Let the original speed be S km/h.

⇒ Distance = Original Speed × Original Time = S × 2

⇒ Returning Distance = (S + 10) × 1.6

Since the distance is the same:

⇒ 2S = 1.6(S + 10)

⇒ 2S = 1.6S + 16

⇒ 2S − 1.6S = 16

⇒ 0.4S = 16

⇒ S = 16 ÷ 0.4

⇒ S = 160 ÷ 4 = 40 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed, Distance, and Time Relation

The fundamental formula is Distance = Speed × Time. When distance is constant, speed and time are inversely proportional (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Average Speed for Constant Distance

If a person travels equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed for the whole journey is (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: A triangle has angles in the ratio 2:3:4. What are the angles?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of angles = 2 : 3 : 4

Total units = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 units

Since total angle sum is 180°, 9 units = 180°

1 unit = 180° ÷ 9 = 20°

Angles are (2 × 20°), (3 × 20°), (4 × 20°) = 40°, 60°, 80°

**∴ The correct answer is 40°, 60°, 80°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of angles = 2 : 3 : 4

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/956aa8ceb0bfad9a0a5276c901b5fcd926959ed460b9a7ad0cf36116183f06d0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the three angles of the triangle be 2x, 3x, and 4x.

⇒ According to the angle sum property:

⇒ 2x + 3x + 4x = 180°

⇒ 9x = 180°

⇒ x = 180° ÷ 9

⇒ x = 20°

⇒ First angle = 2x = 2 × 20° = 40°

⇒ Second angle = 3x = 3 × 20° = 60°

⇒ Third angle = 4x = 4 × 20° = 80°

**∴ The correct answer is 40°, 60°, 80°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all internal angles of any triangle is always 180° or π radians.

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of its two opposite interior angles.

Classification by Angles

Triangles are Acute (all angles 90°).

Polygon Angle Sum Formula

Sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon is given by (n − 2) × 180°.</p

questions.question: A cone has a slant height of 13 cm and a vertical height of 5 cm. What is the radius of the base?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The relationship between vertical height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) of a cone forms a right-angled triangle.

Identify the standard Pythagorean triplet where the hypotenuse is 13 and one side is 5.

The triplet (5, 12, 13) satisfies the condition: 5² + 12² = 13².

Since height h = 5 cm and slant height l = 13 cm, the radius r must be 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Slant height (l) = 13 cm

Vertical height (h) = 5 cm

**Formula:**

In a right circular cone, the slant height is given by: l² = r² + h²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d78f2d97f0f20568df67808d7f1e05e8ac3b762bb9084c96ac1eb8b459f21035.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 13² = r² + 5²

⇒ 169 = r² + 25

⇒ r² = 169 − 25

⇒ r² = 144

⇒ r = √144

⇒ r = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

The volume (V) is one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = (1/3) × πr²h.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved part of the cone is given by: CSA = π × r × l.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the base area and the curved surface area: TSA = πr² + πrl = πr(r + l).

Common Pythagorean Triplets

Frequently used triplets in exams include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25).</p
